name: tlc
description: Type like Chuck - one more AI autocomplete tool

tlc.baseUrl.description: Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible API (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:1234/v1).

tlc.model.description: Model name sent in completion requests. Use the "TLC: Select Model" command to pick one from the server's /v1/models list.

enumDescriptions: User-defined template from the Prefix / Suffix / Middle / Stop settings below
tlc.promptTemplate.description: Built-in FIM prompt template, or "custom" to use the markers from the Prefix / Suffix / Middle / Stop settings below. Tip: "TLC: Create Template" copies the elements of the selected template into those settings.

tlc.prefix.markdownDescription: Marker placed before the code prefix. These fields always mirror the selected template: choosing a built-in template overwrites them, editing any of them switches Prompt Template to `custom` and your values are used.

tlc.suffix.markdownDescription: Marker placed before the code suffix. These fields always mirror the selected template: choosing a built-in template overwrites them, editing any of them switches Prompt Template to `custom` and your values are used.

tlc.middle.markdownDescription: Marker placed after the suffix, where generation begins. These fields always mirror the selected template: choosing a built-in template overwrites them, editing any of them switches Prompt Template to `custom` and your values are used.

tlc.stop.markdownDescription: Reserved tokens used as stop sequences and masked in user code, comma-separated. These fields always mirror the selected template: choosing a built-in template overwrites them, editing any of them switches Prompt Template to `custom` and your values are used.

tlc.contextMaxLength.description: Maximum combined prefix+suffix context (characters). Filled automatically from /v1/models when the model is updated; 0 means unlimited. When exceeded, the prefix and suffix budgets are scaled proportionally with priority to the prefix.

tlc.prefixContextMaxLength.description: Maximum number of characters of code before the cursor sent as context.

tlc.suffixContextMaxLength.description: Maximum number of characters of code after the cursor sent as context.

tlc.maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens to generate.

tlc.autoTrigger.description: Trigger completions automatically after a typing pause. When off, completions are only requested via the manual shortcut (Ctrl+Alt+Space).

tlc.debounceMs.description: How long (in milliseconds) typing must pause before an automatic completion request is sent.

tlc.pendingGraceMs.description: How long (in milliseconds) typing past a pending request waits for its result before discarding it and requesting afresh after the debounce pause. 0 never waits.

tlc.cacheEnabled.description: Re-serve the last completion at the same cursor position without a new API request.

tlc.cacheTtlMs.description: Lifetime of the cached completion in milliseconds.

tlc.forbiddenFileNames.description: Glob patterns of files in which completions are disabled (e.g. .env, *.secret).

scripts.package: npm run compile && node scripts/make-icon.mjs && vsce package --no-dependencies
scripts.test: npm run unit && npm run compile-tests && vscode-test
